citations.title: Data Privacy & Security in Your Digital Analytics
excerpts: ## Industry Certifications

As noted above, Quantum Metric manages an extensive set of IT security controls and policies, taking stringent measures to ensure the security of all data. Quantum Metric regularly conducts and maintains independent verification of security and privacy controls of our internal products and services. This is performed by respected auditing firms, to ensure the company is meeting its strict compliance obligations. Quantum Metric has attained the coveted and venerable SOC2 +HITRUST attestation, demonstrating our unconditional commitment to data protection, privacy, and security. Moreover, we are fully ISO/IEC 27001 certified, as well as strictly complying with global privacy standards such as GDPR and CCPA. Because Quantum Metric takes stringent measures to avoid receiving PII from its customers, the data Quantum Metric processes on behalf of its customers, allows them to maintain their own compliance with PCI, HIPAA, GLBA or similar laws regulating PII.

excerpts: ## Industry Certifications

As noted above, Quantum Metric manages an extensive set of IT security controls and policies, taking stringent measures to ensure the security of all data. Quantum Metric regularly conducts and maintains independent verification of security and privacy controls of our internal products and services. This is performed by respected auditing firms, to ensure the company is meeting its strict compliance obligations. Quantum Metric has attained the coveted and venerable SOC2 +HITRUST attestation, demonstrating our unconditional commitment to data protection, privacy, and security. Moreover, we are fully ISO/IEC 27001 certified, as well as strictly complying with global privacy standards such as GDPR and CCPA. Because Quantum Metric takes stringent measures to avoid receiving PII from its customers, the data Quantum Metric processes on behalf of its customers, allows them to maintain their own compliance with PCI, HIPAA, GLBA or similar laws regulating PII.
